name: Low Testosterone (TRT)
title: Low Testosterone Treatment & TRT in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Low testosterone testing and testosterone replacement therapy in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Injections, gels, patches, and pellets, monitored with regular labs.
h1: Low energy. Low drive. Get it checked.
lede: Testosterone falls naturally with age, and for some men it drops low enough to affect energy, strength, focus, and sexual health. Dr. Khan confirms it with blood work and, when it fits, treats it with monitored testosterone therapy.
glance: Diagnosis with labs, then testosterone therapy tailored and monitored by your doctor.

signs.heading: Signs of low testosterone
signs.intro: Symptoms build slowly and are easy to blame on age or stress. A blood test tells you for sure.

basics.heading: What causes it
paras: Hypogonadism means the testicles are not producing enough testosterone. It can come from aging, or from a problem with the pituitary gland, which signals the testicles to make testosterone.

For many men, testosterone therapy restores levels and reverses symptoms. If the pituitary is the cause, pituitary hormones may need to be replaced instead. Treatment is customized and checked with regular labs.

options.name: Pellet therapy
options.text: Bioidentical testosterone in a rice-sized pellet under the skin, for steady levels without daily dosing.

steps.heading: From test to treatment
items: Comprehensive blood work to confirm low testosterone and find the cause.
Therapy and delivery method chosen with you.
Follow-up labs to keep levels in a healthy range.

faq: How do I know if my testosterone is low?
Only a blood test can confirm it. Dr. Khan orders the right labs, ideally drawn in the morning when levels peak.
It can lower sperm production. If you are planning to have children, tell Dr. Khan so he can factor that into your plan.
How long until I notice a difference?
Many men notice changes in energy and mood within weeks, with other changes over a few months. Results vary.
